standard_prerequisites.name: The maps (eta_f M)^i tensor B -> g^i N^i tensor g^{i+1} N^{i+1} and (eta_g N)^i -> g^i N^i tensor g^{i+1} N^{i+1} are inclusions of direct summands
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets the comparison be checked after localization.

core_obligations: Set N^i = M^i tensor_A B; since f maps to the nonzerodivisor g, the submodule f^i M^i tensor_A B of (N^i)_g identifies with g^i N^i (proof lines 28115-28118). By the eta-locally-free lemma the two maps (eta_f M)^i tensor B -> g^i N^i tensor g^{i+1} N^{i+1} and (eta_g N)^i -> g^i N^i tensor g^{i+1} N^{i+1} are inclusions of direct summands (proof lines 28119-28123). Their images agree after localizing at g, where eta inverts to the identity comparison; two direct summand inclusions with the same localization agree, giving the canonical isomorphism eta_f M tensor_A B = eta_g (M tensor_A B) (proof lines 28123-28123).
proof_roadmap: Identify the base-changed submodules f^i M^i with g^i N^i (proof lines 28115-28118).
Compare the two direct summand inclusions after localizing at g (proof lines 28119-28124).
difficulty_reason: 11 行、eta 构造的基变换相容：N^i = M^i⊗B，f 对应非零除子 g，子模 f^iM^i⊗B 在 (N^i)_g 中即 g^iN^i；eta-locally-free 引理给出两条到 g^iN^i⊗g^{i+1}N^{i+1} 的直和项包含；两包含在 g 处局部化后像一致，直和项包含由局部化确定，故 η_fM⊗_A B ≅ η_g(M⊗_A B) 典范同构。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。
